title: Interim leadership — LucrumTech
description: Interim leadership for three moments: when something has broken, when the company has stopped moving, and when it's scaling into enterprise. We can start within 72 hours.

hero.h1: Some transitions a team can't run on its own.
hero.h1Muted: We come in and own them.
hero.lede: Interim leadership for three moments: when something has broken, when the company has stopped moving, and when it's scaling into enterprise and the old way of working has stopped working.
hero.lede2: We find what's actually wrong and fix it. Not a deck. Not a recommendation. Ownership until it works.

diagnosis.h2: The visible problem is usually not the real problem.
diagnosis.body: A hiring problem is often an organisational design problem. A performance problem is often a leadership problem. A retention problem is often a management problem. A delivery problem is often a decision-making problem.
diagnosis.body2: Most interventions fail because they treat the symptom that is loudest rather than the cause that is upstream. We start by finding which one you actually have.

items: Releases keep slipping and nobody can say what ships next
The architecture won't take the load and the team is permanently firefighting
Key people are leaving and you don't know why yet
A management layer is the problem and nobody will say it out loud
Everyone is busy and nothing material ships
The same problems return every quarter in a different shape
You doubled headcount and execution got worse, not better
Every decision still routes back through you
Enterprise customers are asking for things you don't have — security reviews, SLAs, audit trails
The way you worked at 20 people is breaking at 80
Procurement, compliance and legal are in every deal now, and nobody owns that
You need process without becoming the kind of company that is all process

symptoms.closing: If more than two of these are true at once, that isn't a set of problems. It's one problem you haven't found yet.

how.h2: Two weeks. Fixed scope, fixed fee.

steps.body: We talk to everyone: leadership, managers, and the people actually doing the work. Separately, and in confidence.
We map what is really happening against what you believe is happening. The gap between those two is usually the whole answer.
A written diagnosis: the root cause, what it is costing you, and what we would do about it. Including, when it's true, that you don't need us.
The diagnosis is yours either way. If you want us to execute it, we come in as interim leadership and own the fix until it holds.

how.strong: No retainer to start. No commitment past week two.

build.eyebrow: We can also build the fix
build.h2: Most crisis work ends with a report. Ours can end with the thing rebuilt.
build.body: If the diagnosis finds a platform that won't hold, a product that needs rebuilding, or automation that should have existed two years ago, we have senior engineers who can do it — not a referral to another vendor. That is the difference between advisory and ownership.
